arguments.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import glob
for p in glob.glob('docs/*.md'):
    s=open(p).read(); n=s.replace('[Inputs and outputs](inputs.md)','[Inputs](../README.md#inputs)').replace('(inputs.md)','(../README.md#inputs)')
    if n!=s: open(p,'w').write(n); print('fixed',p)
p='CONTRIBUTING.md'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('compare [`docs/inputs.md`](docs/inputs.md) with','compare the inputs table in [`README.md`](README.md#inputs) with'); open(p,'w').write(s)
for p in ['src/action-docs.test.ts','src/defaults.test.ts']:
    s=open(p).read()
    s=s.replace('const INPUTS_DOC = readFileSync("docs/inputs.md", "utf8");','const README = readFileSync("README.md", "utf8");').replace('INPUTS_DOC','README')
    s=s.replace('docs/inputs.md input table not found','README input table not found').replace('in the docs/inputs.md table','in the README inputs table').replace('the docs/inputs.md table','the README inputs table').replace('and docs/inputs.md','and README')
    open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
grep -rn "inputs.md" docs README.md CONTRIBUTING.md src | cut -c1-120; grep -rn "README.md#inputs" docs | cut -c1-90; sed -n '/^## Inputs/,/^## Documentation/p' README.md | head -12
